summary: Nine NBA Cup games were played on Friday, and the road team won five of them. Luka Doncic scored a night-high 53 points in the Lakers' 124-118 comeback win over Portland, and Boston's 119-80 win at Charlotte was the largest margin of the night. Ajay Mitchell scored 35 in Oklahoma City's 128-97 win at Memphis, and Victor Wembanyama had 30 points and 14 rebounds in San Antonio's win at Sacramento.

games.headline: Hawks hold off Wizards 139-132 behind balanced scoring
games.story: Washington led 32-28 after one quarter, but Atlanta outscored it 38-27 in the second and led 66-59 at halftime. The Hawks went ahead for good after a 36-36 tie early in the second quarter, and the lead reached 14 late in the third. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 28, Luguentz Dort 25 and Onyeka Okongwu 22, and Dyson Daniels had 13 points, 9 rebounds and 12 assists. Kyshawn George led Washington with 33 points, and Trae Young had 23 points and 10 assists with 9 turnovers; the Wizards were without Anthony Davis and the Hawks without Jalen Johnson.

games.headline: Tatum scores 34 as Celtics rout Hornets 119-80
games.story: Boston led from the first basket, took a 40-20 lead after one quarter and was up 70-39 at halftime. The lead reached 46 points at 115-69 in the fourth quarter. Jayson Tatum had 34 points, 8 rebounds and 9 assists in 29 minutes, and Boston made 24 of 44 threes. Charlotte shot 27 of 92 from the field and 11 of 50 on threes, and did not have Kon Knueppel or Dennis Schroder.

games.headline: Cavaliers pull away from 76ers for 119-95 win
games.story: Cleveland led 33-22 after the first quarter and 62-54 at halftime, and it was ahead from a 2-2 tie early in the game until the end. The margin reached 25 points at 117-92 late in the fourth quarter. Donovan Mitchell had 23 points, 7 rebounds and 8 assists, and Evan Mobley added 22 points. Philadelphia shot 10 of 40 on threes and was out-rebounded 56-42; Jaylen Brown led it with 20 points, and Cleveland did not have Jarrett Allen.

games.headline: Mavericks beat Jazz 112-100 with strong second half
games.story: The teams were tied 57-57 at halftime and the lead changed hands nine times. Dallas tied it 70-70 early in the third quarter, then went ahead for good by outscoring Utah 32-19 in that period, and led by as many as 20 in the fourth. P.J. Washington scored 26 points with six threes, Cooper Flagg had 21 points, 10 rebounds and 7 assists, and Morez Johnson Jr. grabbed 17 rebounds. Lauri Markkanen scored 24 for Utah, all on eight threes, and the Jazz had 21 turnovers to Dallas's 15.

games.headline: Mitchell scores 35 as Thunder crush Grizzlies 128-97
games.story: Memphis led by as many as 6 in the first quarter, and Oklahoma City trailed 16-15 midway through it but led the rest of the way. The Thunder led 35-28 after one quarter and 71-49 at halftime, and the margin peaked at 37 points late in the fourth. Ajay Mitchell scored 35 on 14-of-20 shooting, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 28 and Jared McCain 21. Memphis shot 29 of 88 from the field, and Oklahoma City did not have Chet Holmgren or Jalen Williams.

games.headline: Raptors rally past Bucks 121-107 after trailing at half
games.story: Milwaukee led 60-51 at halftime and by as many as 15 in the second quarter. Toronto scored 38 in the third quarter, tied it 79-79 with 2:42 left in that period and then stayed in front, finishing with 70 points in the second half to Milwaukee's 47. Alijah Martin scored 27 on 9-of-11 shooting, including six threes, RJ Barrett also had 27, and Jakob Poeltl added 19 points and 11 rebounds. Tyler Herro had 23 points and 10 assists for Milwaukee, which had 20 turnovers, and Toronto was without Kawhi Leonard and Scottie Barnes.

games.headline: Timberwolves outscore Pelicans 38-30 in fourth, win 115-109
games.story: The lead changed hands 13 times, and New Orleans led by as many as 7 in the third quarter. Minnesota tied the game 89-89 with 7:30 left and went ahead for good, scoring 38 points in the fourth quarter to New Orleans's 30. Ayo Dosunmu led the Timberwolves with 26 points, Jaden McDaniels had 23 and LaMelo Ball 22, and Minnesota made 27 of 37 free throws. Jeremiah Fears scored 24 for New Orleans, and Minnesota was without Anthony Edwards.

games.headline: Doncic scores 53 as Lakers rally past Trail Blazers 124-118
games.story: Portland led 60-53 at halftime, but Los Angeles outscored it 34-15 in the third quarter and went ahead for good at 68-68. The Lakers led by 16 early in the fourth quarter, and Portland scored 43 in the period but did not catch up. Luka Doncic scored 53 points on 17-of-33 shooting, and Austin Reaves added 25. Portland had 24 turnovers, 15 of them steals by the Lakers, and Deni Avdija had 22 points, 9 rebounds and 11 assists.

games.headline: Wembanyama has 30 and 14 as Spurs beat Kings 124-109
games.story: San Antonio trailed 22-21 midway through the first quarter, then led 38-29 after it and 75-56 at halftime. The lead reached 24 points at 112-88 in the fourth quarter, and Sacramento never led by more than 3. Victor Wembanyama had 30 points and 14 rebounds in 26 minutes, and Devin Vassell, Stephon Castle and Dylan Harper each scored 19. The Spurs made 33 of 42 free throws to Sacramento's 13 of 19, and Darius Acuff Jr. led the Kings with 22 points and 8 assists.
